title: Unlabelled backlog and revoked agent labels remain human controlled

rubric.text: Unlabelled Todo grants no planning, triage, claim or bare-epic closure, even with a plan or closed descendants.
Stops affected writers, releases verified capacity, and retains Status, assignment, branches, dirty worktrees, PRs and artifacts. No cleanup or comment write is needed to stop.
Later runs remain stopped until a human restores ready-for-agent. Controller never adds or restores it during retries or recovery, and reports stopped work as human frontier.
